labels.caption: Lenders calibrated out of sample on 1 cell per fold (policy seed 0). Forward fold: the MaaS lenders calibrated on days 1–4 of the trace week and evaluated on days 5–7; reverse fold: calibrated on days 4–7 and evaluated on days 1–3; in both folds, the spot lenders calibrated on weeks 1–12 of their series and evaluated on a 72-h block after them; in sample: the same cell and demand, with every lender calibrated on its whole series, the evaluated window included. (a) Per cell, out of sample, the least primary baseline minus Sublet on the trace cost and on W0 (positive: Sublet costs less; shaded: a negative or missing margin); Sublet's cost is below every primary baseline in 1 (forward) and 1 (reverse) of 1 cells. (b) Trace cost and (c) W0 of Sublet, critical-ratio renting and each primary baseline, out of sample minus in sample: median over the cells (marker) and min-max (bar); grey: no change.
